descriptions.w3d_d20e_register_camera_properties_8024: Registers the camera tuning properties (descriptors 0x803c3580..0x803c3bd4: AntiGimScale, DblHitThres, DefaultHeight ... ZoomOffsetDist) through the scalar, value and bit binding helpers 0x801ec52c/0x801ec0f8/0x801ebf38, creates the TailOffset and HeadOffset vector bindings (0x801f0210) reset to the constant 0x803c3c5c (0.0f), calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
